query:
The group regularly does a shared meal before dark-sky sessions — Cecilia organises these and they seem like part of the tradition. Does this actually apply to all members? If not, who opts out and how does the chat show this?

Options:
A. Jerome
B. Tomás
C. Ruth
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:36:00) ok back to Feb 17th logistics, do we want to do the group meal first or go straight to site? I was thinking Thai takeaway at mine at 6:30 then car share to Blackmoor by 8? 🍜🌟
[2] (about=Ruth, episodic, t4 @2026-03-06T20:10:00) Is it possible that we compromise, perhaps one deeper-dark-sky session per season for those who want it, with Blackmoor remaining the default? That way nobody is left out on the regular outings.
[3] (about=Ruth, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:44:00) In favour. Though I would note that for a pure double-star session on a steady night, Blackmoor is still adequate. Seeing matters more than darkness for splitting tight pairs.
[4] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:29:00) I came to a public star party three years ago expecting to be bored and left having already signed up for the next session. I think most people here have a version of that story. One look at something real through an eyepiece and that's it, you're done. I am organising the annual dark-sky weekend again for next October and I would love for Harriet to record the whole event for the podcast!!! 🌟🌟🌟
[5] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:22:00) Ruth and I met at the county natural-history society in 2021 and discovered within about twenty minutes that we both preferred the stars to anything else on the programme. We agreed to meet the following Friday with our own telescopes in my back garden. There were two of us, a 4-inch refractor, Ruth's old 80mm, and a thermos of tea. I remember we stayed out until 2am on a school night and neither of us could see the point of going in. It grew from there one person at a time. In my experience the quiet beginning is the only honest beginning a group like this can have.
[6] (about=Cecilia, core, t8 @2026-05-08T20:16:00) Cecilia agreed to organise a proper dark-sky weekend trip this summer, suggesting a two-hour drive with accommodation.
[7] (about=Cecilia, core, t14 @2026-08-07T20:11:00) Cecilia came to a public star party three years ago expecting to be bored and left having signed up for the next session; she is organising the annual dark-sky weekend again for next October and wants Harriet to record the whole event for the podcast.
[8] (about=Harriet, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:40:00) I want to do an episode built around that weekend. The group, the dark sky, the contrast between people seeing it for the first time and veterans like Nadia who have been chasing this for thirty years. Dev, your reaction on the night would be perfect audio.
[9] (about=Jerome, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:38:00) I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.
[10] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:38:00) dev and I stayed up till 3am watching jupiter and saturn transit. the seeing came up to 4/5 around 1am and at 400x on jupiter you could see three festoons in the NEB simultaneously. that's the best planetary night I've had in two years
[11] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:31:00) I have been saying this since session one. In my experience there is no substitute for genuine darkness. The Milky Way shadow phenomenon happens around SQM 22.0 or above. You cannot replicate it closer to town, full stop.
[12] (about=Ruth, said_by=Harriet, profile, t10 @2026-06-05T20:23:00) Harriet noted Ruth said on Saturday night that she had been recommending books about dark skies for years but had never actually experienced one; Harriet wants to use it as the episode's opening line.
[13] (about=Ruth, core, t4 @2026-03-06T19:49:00) Ruth proposes a compromise of one deeper-dark-sky session per season for those who want it, with Blackmoor remaining the default.
agent_answer:
**A. Jerome**

The shared pre-session meal does **not** apply to all members. The chat shows **Jerome** opting out: he says he will **go straight to site**, because he needs to be **set up and aligned by 7:45** and **dinner beforehand doesn’t work with his acquisition schedule**.

No similar opt-out is recorded for Tomás, Ruth, or Marcus on this point.
